messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert - Lodestar dedicated pool 'dedicated-lodestar-1' high tail latency in canary lane. Paging: @Maya (oncall). metrics: 95th=1.8s, error-rate=3.4% over 5m.
Maya: I’m up — looking. Any customer reports?
Alex (Lodestar): We started seeing timeouts at ~10:12 for a portion of traffic, intermittent. We routed to fallback but saw user-facing errors.
Maya: thanks Alex. Jeff — did the canary rollout finish earlier today?
Jeff: we rolled pinned artifact v2026.03.15-rc3 to canary at 09:50, staged to 10% traffic. Nothing else bumped after that.
Kate: quick check — autoscale behaved, but queuing on the dedicated pool jumped. Seeing KV cache miss rate spike for long ctx.
Dmitri: copying logs from the node that hit the tail: ```
2026-03-15T10:11:34Z ERROR tokenizer oom while prepping inputs
BACKTRACE: runtime/gpu-alloc
latency_ms=2045 model=Lodestar-7B-quant
```
Maya: interesting — tokenizer OOMs could be quant path related. Could be pinned artifact compiled with a new kernel.
Liam: deploy-bot shows the canary pinned to artifact sha: a3f7c9d. That artifact included a new fused-kernel set.
Maya: plan proposal: 1) Freeze canary (stop further traffic ramp) 2) Divert canary traffic to previous pinned artifact (rollback canary) 3) Evacuate affected tenant slices if needed (temporary isolation) 4) Start an artifact pinback to v2026.03.08-stable.
Jeff: I can stop the ramp and pin traffic back to stable in ~3m. Any reason to do a full rollback across the dedicated pool?
Kate: prefer targeted canary rollback first; full pool would be noisy and affect other customers. But we should pre-warm stable kernels to avoid cold misses.
Dmitri: to pinback: ```
# ops action
./deployctl pin-artifact --pool dedicated-lodestar-1 --artifact v2026.03.08-stable --lane canary
```
Maya: Jeff — request you run that and confirm. Jeff: starting now.
deploy-bot: Action initiated by Jeff. Pinback job id=pb-8892. Canary ramp paused.
Jeff: pinback complete, job pb-8892 success. Rolling routing table to v2026.03.08-stable for canary lane.
Maya: @Alex can you verify traffic to your canary slice? Did errors drop?
Alex (Lodestar): immediate improvement. Timeouts went from ~12/min to 0 within two minutes. Users report fewer errors. Thanks.
Kate: monitoring: 95th latency down to 420ms, error-rate -> 0.2% on that slice. Good.
Maya: next: run quick synthetic convo test against both pinned artifact and the fused-kernel artifact in an isolated env to reproduce tokenizer OOM consistently. Jeff/Dmitri take.
Dmitri: reproducing locally — running the long-context test case: ```
python -m tests.long_context --model Lodestar-7B-quant --artifact a3f7c9d
```
Result: tokenizer memory climb > GPU mem budget at seq_len=8k. Fused kernel attempt to allocate 14GB on a 12GB instance.
Jeff: looks like the fused kernel build omitted a fallback memory cap. We'll block that kernel until we fix allocator.
Maya: Customer impact assessment: affected region us-west-2, approx 6% of Lodestar tenant traffic (canary slice). No billing anomalies noted. Operational impact: user-facing timeouts for ~10m, mitigated by pinback.
Liam: I'll file a postmortem stub and link runbook entries: runbook/dedicated-pinback, runbook/kernel-compat.
Maya: On-call handoff scheduled at 11:00 PST. @Kate will take next shift. Kate — anything you want to add before handoff?
Kate: make sure to follow up with QA for kernel memcap test and add synthetic test to CI for quant fused kernels. Also add a guard: if tokenizer OOM seen in canary > 1%, auto-pinback.
Maya: noted. @Alex — Lodestar ops, any change requests?
Alex (Lodestar): Would like a short note to our SREs (we'll take it internal), and a request to avoid auto-ramping new fused kernels to canary until validated.
Maya: good ask. We'll set a temporary policy: no fused-kernel artifacts to canary without allocator memcap test passing.
deploy-bot: rolling pinback for global routing unaffected. No further action needed.
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated. Severity stays P1 until postmortem. Investigator: Maya. TL;DR: pinned artifact fused-kernel led to tokenizer OOM under long-context; canary pinback to previous artifact resolved customer-facing errors.
Jeff: I'll open an internal PR to add allocator guard and a changelog note.
Dmitri: I'll push a hotfix branch for the allocator; will test on isolated infra. ETA 6h.
Maya: handoff to Kate now. Kate — take lead and coordinate postmortem. Tagging: @Liam for docs, @Jeff for deploy action, @Dmitri for fix.
Kate: got it. I'll create the postmortem doc and ping legal if customer letter is needed.
Alex (Lodestar): appreciate the quick response. Please loop in account team if you plan any rolling restarts.
Maya: will do. Closing thread for live ops — keep updates on the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
